dct_description_sm: Abstract: This layer describes railway routes and railway bridges throughout China represented by lines and annotation.

Purpose: This transportation data layer documents the railways that link urban and rural areas. It is essential to illustrate and analyze the regional aspects of human-induced land transformations. Applications, such as the exploration of the development of transportation routes and networks and its correlation to key urban growth processes, will be of use to urban and regional planners, policy and decision-makers, earth scientists, and global change researchers. These data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information on transportation and associated areas of interest, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data
